'''Qoussk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] who operated a specialty goods kiosk in the [[Concourse Bazaar]] of the [[Old Galactic Market]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Qoussk had a [[Color/Legends|purple]] [[exoskeleton]] and turquoise [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
